name: Cook & Persinger 2001: frequency-modulated field, right hemisphere (20 min)
summary: The Thomas pattern (849 points at 3-ms points) primarily over the right hemisphere for 20 min, as in Cook & Persinger 2001. The paper (16 people, no sham group) reports a sensed presence, a 'sentient being', in 6 of 8 people with above-average temporal-lobe-sign scores (75%) and in none of the below-average scorers.
notes: The paper applied a frequency-modulated (Thomas pulse) pattern with pixel durations of 3 ms primarily over the right hemisphere for 20 min (Cook 2001 p.1 [447]). It refers to Persinger 2000 for the procedure: one left-right solenoid pair on for 0.5 s at a time, 3 ms between patterns, and at the scalp about 5 uT over the right temporal region against 1 uT over the left (Persinger 2000 p.3 [661]). This program plays those values: the 849-point table (Table 1 of US 6,234,953) at 3 ms per point with a 3-ms pause, a 2.55-s cycle. One left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The left side plays at one fifth, after the ratio in Persinger 2000; this study's own ratio is not stated, and other lab papers give 10 to 1 or 2 to 3 to 1. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. The table matches the description in Buckner 2015 p.2 (18 doublets); it was not compared point for point with the lab's file, whose length the lab's papers give as 849, 837, 859 or 890 points. Field: the paper gives 1 uT without saying where it was measured (p.1 [447]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Support: each of the 16 people also received 20 min of bilateral burst-firing, with the order reversed in half (p.1 [447]; see persinger-burst-temporal-bilateral). There was no sham group: the sham rates the paper quotes (20% and 9%) come from the lab's database (p.2 [448]). One lab, not repeated. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history, implanted devices or pregnancy; stop at once on fear, headache or distress.
setting: A darkened, quiet room, eyes covered, reclining; note the time and side of anything felt.
schedule: One 20-min exposure; at most once a week. Compare with a blinded sham (the app's Blind option).
